style_en: Vertical 9:16 miniature diorama 3D CG render in an empty white space. Smooth faceless figurines (no eyes, nose or mouth details). Soft shadows, slightly high angle. Mostly white, gray and blue-gray, only key objects red. Keep the top 35% of the frame empty with no heads or objects; place the main subject between 35% and 68% of the height, centered. Everything from the single year 2021; no extra props from other eras.
avoid_en: logos, brand names, readable text or numbers, flags, blood, wounds, teeth on the whale, a person visible inside a mouth, faces resembling real people

diver.desc_en: the diver, a man figurine with a smooth featureless face, plain black wetsuit, black fins, a single gray air tank on his back, a plain diving mask, no logos
